svg.style: position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; margin: 0; padding: 0; z-index: 999999; background-color: #121212;

body.style: margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;

iframe.style: width: 500%; height: 500%; border: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; transform: scale(0.20); transform-origin: top left; display: block;
